english:
Being Transcendent grants 10% increased Grenade and Melee Damage.

Each Weapon Kill after Transcendence ends grants 4.17% Light and Darkness Energy, up to 50% Light and Darkness Energy at 12 kills.

source.text:
While Transcendent:
10% Increased Grenade and Melee Damage.

After Transcendence ends:
Each Weapon Kill scored grants 4.17% Light and Darkness Energy.
Grants up to 50% Light/Dark Energy after 12 kills.
